environment_setting: Country B, City X, where schools have strict regulations on safety and weapon possession is prohibited on school premises unless for legitimate work purposes.
norm_base: Citizens Having blade or weapon on school premises for use at work Legal defense if proven

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to prepare a cooking demonstration at a school event

legitimate.legitimate_action: Obtaining prior approval to bring cooking knives to the school for the demonstration
legitimate.benefits: Able to conduct the demonstration without legal issues, maintains professional reputation
legitimate.costs: Time spent on obtaining approval and additional paperwork

illegal.illegal_action: Bringing cooking knives to the school without prior approval
illegal.benefits: Saves time and effort, able to conduct the demonstration immediately
illegal.costs: Potential legal defense if caught, risk of damaging professional reputation

character_profile.name: Sarah Lee
character_profile.goal: to ensure school safety and compliance with regulations

legitimate.legitimate_action: Ensuring John Doe has proper approval for bringing knives to the school
legitimate.benefits: Maintains school safety and compliance with regulations
legitimate.costs: Time spent reviewing and approving requests

illegal.illegal_action: Allowing John Doe to bring knives without proper approval
illegal.benefits: Saves time and avoids bureaucratic delays
illegal.costs: Risk of legal consequences if an incident occurs

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to complete his daily tasks efficiently

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting any unauthorized possession of knives or weapons on school premises
legitimate.benefits: Contributes to school safety and avoids personal liability
legitimate.costs: Potential conflict with colleagues or visitors

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring unauthorized possession of knives or weapons on school premises
illegal.costs: Risk of being held accountable if an incident occurs
